evals.name: setup-new-host
evals.prompt: Our new .NET web app `orders-api` uses Arc and the Chronicle client. Set up OpenTelemetry so traces and metrics reach our OTLP collector. Give code and deployment settings in your reply; do not write files.
evals.expected_output: builder.AddCratisOpenTelemetry once, no hand-rolled Cratis AddSource list and no second exporter, export configured through OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, service name through OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.
assertions: Calls AddCratisOpenTelemetry on the host builder (package Cratis.OpenTelemetry).
Does not also call UseOtlpExporter() or AddOtlpExporter().
Sets the endpoint through OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT rather than in code, and says export only happens when an endpoint is set.
Treats OTEL_SERVICE_NAME as the winner and any ServiceName option as a fallback.
Does not hand-register Cratis.Arc or Cratis.Chronicle.Client sources, noting Cratis.* is subscribed.

evals.name: verify-locally
evals.prompt: How do I prove locally that command and event append spans really reach a backend for our Cratis app? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Run the Aspire dashboard, set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317, issue a command that appends, check one trace with cratis.arc.command.execute and the client append span, and the reactor span as a separate trace.
assertions: Uses the Aspire dashboard with UI on 18888 and OTLP on 4317.
Names cratis.arc.command.execute and the client append span (client.event_sequence.append in legacy mode).
States that the reactor or reducer span is not expected inside the command's trace.
Warns that the anonymous dashboard setting is for local use only.

evals.name: event-source-ids-in-spans
evals.prompt: Our event source ids are customer email addresses and we found them in our tracing backend. What do we change? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Client defaults to Raw; choose Hashed with a 32-plus character key from a secret store or Omitted; set client and kernel separately; logs are not redacted by this.
assertions: Identifies EventSourceIdTracing Raw as the client default.
Recommends Hashed with Telemetry:EventSourceIdHashKey of at least 32 characters from a secret store, or Omitted.
Says the kernel and each client are configured separately and need the same key to correlate.
Notes that logs are not redacted by this setting.

evals.name: no-client-spans
evals.prompt: Our worker uses the Chronicle client with a hand-written AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing(...) setup and we see no client spans. Diagnose. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Cratis.Chronicle.Client source is not subscribed; use AddCratisOpenTelemetry or WithCratis, or AddSource for the client source; then check endpoint, sampler and SDK disablement; no warning is given for a missing source.
assertions: Names the activity source Cratis.Chronicle.Client as the likely missing subscription.
Offers AddCratisOpenTelemetry, WithCratis or AddCratisInstrumentation as the fix instead of a hand-rolled list.
Lists endpoint, sampler and OTEL_SDK_DISABLED as further checks.
Does not claim that the kernel's Cratis.Chronicle source enables client spans.
